fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: ecl::sound::MusicRequest (stride 0x30). PrioritizeMusicRequests (EoCClient.dll+0xE05160) initialises +0 with the null entity handle 0xFFC0000000000000.

fields.name: Event
fields.evidence: ls::STDString (24 bytes, = Script Extender STDString) at +8: constructed with STDString::STDString in PrioritizeMusicRequests. Bytes because STDString is not an allowed primitive here.

fields.name: Context
fields.evidence: EMusicEventContext (default 7); PrioritizeMusicRequests takes the minimum of MusicPlayerData+0x60 (= current request +0x20) over all players.

fields.name: IsStart
fields.evidence: Default 1; asserted == 1 for stinger / state-trigger contexts (see MusicRequestsSingletonComponent layout).

fields.name: Is3D
fields.evidence: Asserted 0 for non-diegetic, 1 for diegetic requests in PrioritizeMusicRequests.

fields.name: Player
fields.evidence: Short player id used as the hash key into Players.

fields.name: PendingRequests
fields.evidence: Game: ecl::sound::MusicStateSingletonComponent::MusicPlayerData (value stride 0x70 in PrioritizeMusicRequests: pointer + 0x1C*4). Its first 64 bytes are initialised by FUN_180e03bd0 from a zeroed 64-byte object; macOS has ls::HashMap<ecl::sound::EMusicEventContext, ecl::sound::MusicRequest> (used by GetAnyOtherPendingRequestInContext). Key is the 4-byte enum.

fields.name: Current
fields.evidence: FUN_180e03dd0(data+0x40, request) copies a MusicRequest (null handle, STDString, context 7, -1.0, 1) into +0x40; PrioritizeMusicRequests reads data+0x60 (= +0x40 + Context offset 0x20).

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: ls::Variant<MusicStateSingletonComponent::MusicRequest2D, MusicRequestPositioned> (game names, macOS), stride 0x28 (FUN_18034e690). Alternative 0 (2D) has an STDString at +0; alternative 1 (Positioned) has 8 bytes (probably the emitter entity) then an STDString at +8.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: Rest of the variant payload (STDString of the 2D or positioned alternative).

fields.name: Type
fields.evidence: FUN_18034e690 (element destructor) reads the variant index at +0x20: 0 = MusicRequest2D (string at +0), 1 = MusicRequestPositioned (string at +8).

fields.name: Players
fields.evidence: PrioritizeMusicRequests (EoCClient.dll+0xE05160) gets the singleton (FUN_180e01620), walks keys at +0x20 with stride 2 (short player ids) and values at +0x30 with stride 0x70, looks up by short key (bucket count +8) and inserts a fresh MusicPlayerData when missing. Live: 5 buckets, 1 player.

fields.name: PostedRequests
fields.evidence: PrioritizeMusicRequests destroys every element of the array at +0x40 (size +0x4C) and resets its size each frame; element type ls::Variant<MusicRequest2D, MusicRequestPositioned> (macOS DynamicArray instantiation and the CheckBoundary text in FUN_18034e690). Live: capacity 2-4, size 0.

open_questions: MusicRequest2D / MusicRequestPositioned member layout inside the variant (only the STDString positions are known).
MusicRequest +0x24 float meaning; STDString members declared as bytes.
